content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Persons holding analogous post i.e. regular Assistants of ICAR Hqrs./Institutes; Or by deputation from amongst regular UDCs in an ICAR Institute/Hqrs having at least ten years of regular service in the grade. Experience required: Ten years of regular service as UDC (deputation route). Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Pay Level – 6 in the pay matrix of 7th CPC (Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400) (Pre-revised Pay Band-2 of Rs.9300-34800+Grade Pay of Rs.4200 ). Qualification required: Persons holding analogous post i.e. regular UDC at ICAR Hqrs./Institutes; Or by deputation from amongst regular LDCs in an ICAR Institute/Hqrs having at least eight years of regular service in the grade. Experience required: Eight years of regular service as LDC (deputation route). Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Pay Level – 4 in the pay matrix of 7th CPC (Rs. 25,500 – 81,100) (Pre-revised Pay Band-2 of Rs.5200-20200+Grade Pay of Rs.2400 ). Qualification required: Lower Division Clerk of ICAR Hqrs./Institutes who have successfully completed probation period and confirmed in the ICAR Service, desiring transfer. Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Pay Level – 2 in the pay matrix of 7th CPC (Rs. 19,900 – 63,200) (Pre-revised Pay Band-2 of Rs.5200-20200+Grade Pay of Rs.1900 ).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation initially for two years, extendable by one year on satisfactory completion Posts filled on deputation/transfer on permanent absorption

content_sections.text: Attested copies of APARs for the last five years Certificate that no disciplinary proceedings are pending/contemplated against the official Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate Application in the prescribed proforma with Head of Office certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-NBAIR Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill in the prescribed proforma attached to the notice (page 3). Get the Head of Office certificate on the proforma signed. Attach attested APARs for the last five years, no-disciplinary-proceedings certificate and Vigilance Clearance and Integrity Certificate. Application to be forwarded through the parent ICAR Institute to reach ICAR-NBAIR by 30.11.2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Service in parent institute after last promotion will not count for promotion in the new institute Transferred employee starts afresh at the bottom of the cadre; existing pay will be protected Crucial date of eligibility as per DoPT OM No.22011/6/2013-Estt(D), dated 28.05.2014 Eligibility and conditions as per Council's OM No.Admn.11-2/2022-R&P dated 07.06.2023

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ICAR-NBAIR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-NBAIR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies: 4 Assistant, 2 Upper Division Clerk, 3 Lower Division Clerk.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ICAR-NBAIR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed proforma on page 3 of the notice) and send it to the address given in the notification, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of the receipt of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Level – 6 in the pay matrix of 7th CPC (Rs. 35,400 – 1,12,400) (Pre-revised Pay Band-2 of Rs.9300-34800+Grade Pay of Rs.4200 ) for Assistant, Pay Level – 4 in the pay matrix of 7th CPC (Rs. 25,500 – 81,100) (Pre-revised Pay Band-2 of Rs.5200-20200+Grade Pay of Rs.2400 ) for Upper Division Clerk, Pay Level – 2 in the pay matrix of 7th CPC (Rs. 19,900 – 63,200) (Pre-revised Pay Band-2 of Rs.5200-20200+Grade Pay of Rs.1900 ) for Lower Division Clerk.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Open only to employees of ICAR Institutes/Headquarters/Project Directorates/NRCs/ATARIs. Applicants must hold the analogous post (Assistant/UDC/LDC), or for deputation be regular UDCs with 10 years (for Assistant) or regular LDCs with 8 years (for UDC) of regular service in the grade. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open only to employees working at ICAR Institutes, Headquarters, Project Directorates, NRCs and ATARIs. Candidates must be able to be relieved immediately.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete applications, late applications and those without attested APARs and certificates will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation initially for two years, extendable by one year on satisfactory completion. Posts filled on deputation/transfer on permanent absorption.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ICAR-NBAIR, Bengaluru.
